# Medely

> Medely is the world's largest healthcare talent marketplace connecting nurses, allied professionals, and healthcare facilities through AI-powered workforce orchestration and flexible staffing solutions.

Medely operates a dual-sided platform serving both healthcare workers seeking per-diem shifts and healthcare facilities needing flexible staffing. The platform leverages AI-powered scheduling and workforce management to optimize labor costs and operational efficiency across the healthcare industry.

- [Medely | Build a better workforce. Deliver better care.](https://medely.com): Medely homepage: healthcare staffing platform connecting nurses, allied professionals with facilities

- [Medely's Talent Fusion Flex | The world's largest healthcare talent marketplace | Medely](https://medely.com/facilities/talent-fusion-flex): Talent Fusion Flex: flexible staffing solution accessing 300K+ credentialed healthcare professionals
